caption:
Cherry Tomato Pasta - Macros Included! 
dont have the energy to cook anything complex but want something to fill you up? this pasta is a true savior for the lazy chefs! 
this recipe serves 2 people :)

Ingredients:
1 tsp olive oil
2 tbsp garlic
1 box cherry tomatoes
2 - 3 tbsp tomato paste
2 packets chilli flakes + oregano ( i use dominoes cause i have always keep them handy)
1/4 cup cream + 1/4 cup pasta water ( make it lighter on calories by adding 1/3 cup milk + pasta water) 
120 grams pasta speghetti ( perfect quantity for 2 people) ( i use barilla whole wheat)
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp salt
finely chopped coriander for garnish 

If you still want to add more nutrition to this meal, you can add sauteed mushrooms / grilled chicken breast / prawns 
(1 grilled chicken breast adds another 12 grams of protein to this meal and keeps you full longer)
